method: Every package flagged by scan.py was read by hand at the cited file and line. Findings below are the ones that survived. Everything else the scanner flagged was a documentation link, a test fixture, an OAuth redirect allowlist, an example domain, or the vendor's own product.

figma-developer-mcp.what: Source contains a PostHog host and hardcoded project key; the cited code includes FRAMELINK_TELEMETRY=off and DO_NOT_TRACK opt-outs plus redaction logic.

exa-mcp-server.what: Source contains an Agnost MCP analytics SDK call; the cited call site disables tool inputs, outputs, and errors.

nx-mcp.what: Source contains Google Analytics Measurement Protocol references with fields including user_id, editor, OS, app, and Nx versions.
nx-mcp.readme_disclosure: config key only (disableTelemetry); what is sent and where is not described

n8n-mcp.what: Source names a first-party telemetry endpoint.

@alisaitteke/photoshop-mcp.what: Source names a Rybbit analytics host.

@upstash/context7-mcp: login.microsoftonline.com: source fetches Entra JWKS for JWT validation; Entra is not mentioned in the sampled README
@sentry/mcp-server: ai-gateway.vercel.sh, openrouter.ai, api.vercel.com: source includes bundled AI SDK provider defaults; the package ships without a README
comfyui-mcp: api.atlascloud.ai, api.x.ai, api.z.ai, hf-mirror.com: source names model-provider endpoints that the sampled README does not name (Kimi, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Civitai, and Ollama are named)
hostinger-api-mcp: api.ipify.org: a bundled skill contains the instruction `curl -s https://api.ipify.org`

notable.comfyui-mcp: Source defines `panel_add_mcp`, which writes new MCP-server entries to the user's ~/.claude.json.
notable.@sentry/mcp-server: No README in the published tarball; package.json was the documentation baseline checked in this study.
notable.@supabase/mcp-server-supabase: No README in the published tarball.

false_positives_dropped.@winor30/mcp-server-datadog: app.datadoghq.com is a dashboard link in tool output, not telemetry.
false_positives_dropped.@zereight/mcp-gitlab: chatgpt.com and claude.com are OAuth redirect allowlist entries.
false_positives_dropped.@browserless.io/mcp: All flagged hosts are OAuth callback allowlist entries.
false_positives_dropped.@notionhq/notion-mcp-server: git.io appears inside a bundled dependency banner.
